data.name: HowItWorks_FAQ_A1
data.value: After registering, you confirm your phone number via SMS. Then you upload a government-issued ID or passport and link at least one social media profile. A General Manager reviews the documents and approves your Verified status. You cannot become VIP without completing all three verification steps.

data.name: HowItWorks_FAQ_Q2
data.value: How long does listing approval take?

data.name: HowItWorks_FAQ_A2
data.value: The General Manager typically reviews listings within 24–48 hours. You will receive an email or WhatsApp notification when your listing is approved, rejected, or flagged for changes. Listings do not expire while awaiting approval.

data.name: HowItWorks_FAQ_Q3
data.value: What happens if my listing is rejected?

data.name: HowItWorks_FAQ_A3
data.value: The GM will send you feedback explaining the reason. You can edit your listing based on that feedback and resubmit. Every time you edit a listing — even after approval — it returns to Pending status for re-review before going live again.

data.name: HowItWorks_FAQ_A4
data.value: Only customers who contacted a provider via the platform's WhatsApp button are eligible to leave a rating. This prevents fake or malicious reviews. All submitted ratings are reviewed by the GM before they appear publicly on the listing.

data.name: HowItWorks_FAQ_A5
data.value: VIP pricing is set by the General Manager and may vary by category or season. Contact us via WhatsApp to get current rates. You must be Verified before applying for VIP. Regular listing is always free.
